candidates.title: Magento preference resolves checkout cart
candidates.reason: The Magento preference resolves Acme\Checkout\Api\CartInterface to Acme\Checkout\Model\Cart; this exact relationship is relevant to the changed behavior.
candidates.fix: Correct the implementation behavior while preserving the effective preference.

candidates.title: Magento frontend preference overrides cart
candidates.reason: The Magento frontend preference resolves Acme\Checkout\Api\CartInterface to Acme\Checkout\Model\FrontendCart and changes the effective implementation.
candidates.fix: Align the frontend implementation with the required behavior.

candidates.title: Magento interceptor changes cart execution
candidates.reason: The Magento interceptor Acme\Checkout\Plugin\CartAudit wraps Acme\Checkout\Api\CartInterface and affects the save path.
candidates.fix: Correct the interceptor behavior for the affected save path.

candidates.title: Magento frontend interceptor is disabled
candidates.reason: The Magento frontend interceptor Acme\Checkout\Plugin\CartAudit is disabled for Acme\Checkout\Api\CartInterface, so frontend execution differs from global execution.
candidates.fix: Enable the interceptor or make the area-specific behavior intentional.

candidates.title: Magento observer handles checkout submission
candidates.reason: The Magento observer Acme\Checkout\Observer\Audit handles checkout_submit_all_after and is part of the affected execution path.
candidates.fix: Correct the observer behavior for checkout submission.

candidates.title: Magento frontend observer is disabled
candidates.reason: The Magento observer Acme\Checkout\Observer\Audit is disabled for checkout_submit_all_after in the frontend area.
candidates.fix: Restore the observer or account for the missing frontend side effect.

candidates.title: Magento route changes checkout dispatch
candidates.reason: The Magento route checkout is handled by module Acme_Checkout and therefore reaches the changed module.
candidates.fix: Correct the affected checkout dispatch behavior.

candidates.title: Magento route dispatches cart save
candidates.reason: The Magento route checkout/cart/save dispatches to Acme\Checkout\Controller\Cart\Save and the controller behavior is affected.
candidates.fix: Correct the controller execution path.

candidates.title: Magento webapi invokes cart save
candidates.reason: The Magento webapi route POST /V1/acme/cart invokes Acme\Checkout\Api\CartInterface::save and exposes the changed behavior.
candidates.fix: Correct the service behavior or route contract.

candidates.title: Magento webapi requires cart ACL
candidates.reason: The Magento webapi POST:/V1/acme/cart requires ACL resource Acme_Checkout::cart and authorization behavior is affected.
candidates.fix: Correct the ACL enforcement for the route.

candidates.title: Magento queue dispatches cart handler
candidates.reason: The effective Magento queue route for acme.cart.save dispatches to Acme\Checkout\Model\QueueHandler::process through the default consumer.
candidates.fix: Correct the queue handler behavior while preserving the effective callback.

candidates.title: Final cart interceptor cannot execute
candidates.reason: The configured Magento interceptor Acme\Checkout\Plugin\CartAudit cannot intercept Acme\Checkout\Model\FinalCart::save because the target class is final, so the configured behavior never executes.
candidates.fix: Remove the interceptor from the final target or move the required behavior to an interceptable public method on a non-final class.

candidates.title: Consumer has no queue
candidates.reason: Magento consumer acme.invalid.consumer has an empty queue, so it cannot consume a configured destination.
candidates.fix: Set queue to the exact queue name bound for this consumer.

candidates.title: Array extension join cannot hydrate
candidates.reason: The Magento join for Acme\Checkout\Api\CartInterface.related_items cannot hydrate the declared Acme\Checkout\Api\CartInterface[] array type, so joined data is not populated.
candidates.fix: Remove the join and populate the array through extension-attribute loading code, or change the attribute to a supported scalar object shape.

candidates.title: Missing Magento preference
candidates.reason: Magento has no preference registered for Acme\Checkout\Api\CartInterface.
candidates.fix: Register the missing preference.

candidates.title: Missing Magento observer
candidates.reason: Magento has no observer registered for checkout_submit_all_after.
candidates.fix: Register the observer.

candidates.title: Missing Magento route
candidates.reason: Magento has no route registered for checkout.
candidates.fix: Register the checkout route.

candidates.title: Missing Magento webapi route
candidates.reason: Magento has no webapi route for POST /V1/acme/cart.
candidates.fix: Register the route.

candidates.title: Missing Magento ACL resource
candidates.reason: Magento has no ACL resource registered for Acme_Checkout::cart.
candidates.fix: Register the ACL resource.
